from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MS_SHARED_LOCAL, prompt_custom.MS_SHARED_EDGE, prompt_custom.MS_SHARED_CONTRADICTION], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MS_SHARED_SUMMARY)
        notes = await shared(problem)
        enriched_problem = f"{problem}\n\nShared deduction notes:\n{notes.get('response') or 'No shared notes.'}"
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MS_WORKER_EXTRACT, prompt_custom.MS_WORKER_FRONTIER, prompt_custom.MS_WORKER_CONTRADICTION], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MS_AGGREGATOR_FORMATTED)
        solution = await star(enriched_problem)
        final_response = solution.get("response") or '```\n"Unable to determine any mine locations."\n```'
        return final_response, {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
